name: GoodSync
description_en:
GoodSync is installed file-backup and synchronization software. A job links two locations and can use one-way backup or two-way synchronization across supported devices, network protocols and cloud services. It is a transfer and automation tool; the destinations and their storage charges still need to be provided.

The product family also includes GoodSync Connect, Explorer, Storage and business/server management. This profile focuses on a file job, its preview and conflict behavior, rather than implying every family service is included in a personal license.
description_zh:
GoodSync 是安装式文件备份与同步软件，任务连接两个位置，可在受支持设备、网络协议和云服务之间进行单向备份或双向同步。它负责传输和自动化，目标及其存储费仍需另行准备。

产品家族另含 Connect、Explorer、Storage 和商用／服务器管理。本文重点说明文件任务、预览和冲突行为，不暗示个人许可包含家族全部服务。

review_notes: Draft primary-source research, not an independent review or hands-on product test.
Chinese profile text does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.en:
The documented workflow is to create a job, choose its direction and two folders, then select automation. The manual separates Analyze from Sync and exposes changes, conflicts and errors. Simultaneous edits are a conflict requiring a direction decision; a filesystem error, such as a locked file, is a different failure.

For an evaluation, copy a small disposable folder between a computer and a chosen remote destination. Inspect proposed additions, edits and deletions before syncing. Then edit the same file on both sides and check the conflict handling. This is a suggested test, not an executed result.
sections.zh:
文档流程为创建任务、选择方向和两个目录，再选自动方式。手册将 Analyze 与 Sync 分开，显示变化、冲突和错误。两端同时修改属于需决定方向的冲突，文件被锁等文件系统错误则是另一类失败。

评估可用电脑和所选远程目标传输小型可丢弃目录，同步前检查新增、修改及删除预览，再两端修改同一文件以核对冲突处理。这是建议测试，并非已执行结果。

sections.en:
The manual distinguishes retaining only the last replaced/deleted version in _gsdata_/_saved_ from multiple versions in _gsdata_/_history_. The last-version recycle option defaults to a 30-day cleanup, while history has its own cleanup settings. Disabling retention can make replacement or deletion permanent.

Treat those folders and cleanup policies as part of storage and recovery planning. A mirrored destination alone may reproduce an unwanted deletion. Investigate the job log and actual error after failed execution instead of assuming an enabled scheduler guarantees a current copy.
sections.zh:
手册区分在 _gsdata_/_saved_ 保留最后一次被替换／删除版本，以及在 _gsdata_/_history_ 保留多版本。最后版本回收选项默认 30 天清理，多版本历史另有清理设置；关闭保留可能使替换或删除永久生效。

这些目录及清理策略属于存储和恢复规划的一部分。镜像目标本身可能复制不希望发生的删除。执行失败应检查任务日志和真实错误，不能把调度已开启当作副本已更新。

sections.title_en: Software rights and cloud capacity are separate
sections.title_zh: 软件使用权与云容量分别购买
sections.en:
The current purchase page lists GoodSync Personal at USD 29.95 for one year on up to five Windows, Mac or Linux/NAS devices. GoodSync Storage is a separate annual purchase, including a listed 100-GB option at USD 29.95. The free comparison lists three jobs and 100 files per installation; the homepage describes a 15-day advanced-feature period.

Shortlist it when explicit folder-to-folder control and supported destination access fit. Verify server/business rights, unattended execution credentials and provider limits. A paid software license is not unlimited included cloud storage. No transfer speed, account recovery, full license agreement or provider-specific failure recovery was tested.
sections.zh:
当前购买页列 GoodSync Personal 每年 29.95 美元，最多五台 Windows、Mac 或 Linux／NAS 设备；GoodSync Storage 另按年购买，例如 100 GB 每年 29.95 美元。免费对照列每次安装三项任务和 100 个文件；首页说明高级功能开放 15 天。

需要明确目录间控制且目标访问受支持时，可考虑它。需核对服务器／商用权益、无人值守凭据及云商限制。购买软件不等于附送无限云存储。本文未测试传输速度、账户恢复、完整许可或云商相关失败恢复。
